#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

const int MAX_N = 262144;

int L, n, k, Mo, len;
int bit[20], fac[MAX_N], inv[MAX_N], cnt[MAX_N];
int g[20][MAX_N], f[20][MAX_N];

int pwr(int x, int y) {
    int z = 1;
    for (; y; y >>= 1, x = (ll)x * x % Mo)
        if (y & 1) z = (ll)z * x % Mo;
    return z;
}

void inc(int &x, int y) { x = (x + y >= Mo) ? (x + y - Mo) : (x + y); }
void dec(int &x, int y) { x = (x - y < 0) ? (x - y + Mo) : (x - y); }

void FWT(int *a, int len) {
    for (int i = 1; i < len; i <<= 1)
        for (int j = 0; j < len; j += i << 1)
            for (int k = 0; k < i; k++)
                inc(a[j + k + i], a[j + k]);
}

void IFWT(int *a, int len) {
    for (int i = 1; i < len; i <<= 1)
        for (int j = 0; j < len; j += i << 1)
            for (int k = 0; k < i; k++)
                dec(a[j + k + i], a[j + k]);
}

ll h[20], p[20];

void get_ln() {
    p[0] = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        p[i] = (ll)h[i] * i % Mo;
        for (int j = 1; j < i; j++)
            p[i] = (p[i] - (ll)p[j] * h[i - j] % Mo * j % Mo + Mo) % Mo;
        p[i] = (ll)p[i] * inv[i] % Mo;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) h[i] = (p[i] + Mo) % Mo;
}

void get_exp() {
    p[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        p[i] = 0;
        for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++)
            p[i] = (p[i] + (ll)h[j] * p[i - j] % Mo * j) % Mo;
        p[i] = (ll)p[i] * inv[i] % Mo;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) h[i] = p[i];
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d%d", &L, &k, &Mo);
    int all = pwr(k, L);
    if (L & 1) {
        printf("%d\n", all);
        return 0;
    }
    fac[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= L; i++) fac[i] = (ll)fac[i - 1] * i % Mo;
    inv[L] = pwr(fac[L], Mo - 2);
    for (int i = L - 1; i >= 0; i--) inv[i] = (ll)inv[i + 1] * (i + 1) % Mo;
